FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the AI influencer talking head — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a boom-down from a high wide to a tight insert on a 90mm tilt-shift, framing with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with underlighting from a translucent base panel; grade as a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
